name: HyperFrames Composition Contract
summary: Build renderable HyperFrames compositions using the timing, track, clip, variable and deterministic-render contract.
problem: Composition HTML can silently render incorrectly when timing attributes, tracks, scene dimensions or media ownership violate the runtime contract.
coreOutcomes: Structure root compositions, clips, tracks and sub-compositions
Apply timing attributes and variable conventions
Validate deterministic behavior and composition structure
requirements: A composition brief or existing HTML composition
boundaries: The skill defines the composition contract, not creative direction or animation-runtime APIs
Keep frame output a pure function of the requested composition time
